title: 第13章  灭王澶，青山城轰动！
content_zh:
就在这千钧一发之际，异变陡生！
“呃啊——”
王澶突然发出一声凄厉至极的惨叫，体内灵力瞬间溃散。
他捂着胸口，张口喷出一大口乌黑的血液。
“这是怎么回事？”
王澶瞪大了眼睛，却有些不明所以。
他体内的灵力如同决堤的洪水般疯狂逸散，元婴三重的修为竟然在以肉眼可见的速度跌落！
更恐怖的是，他的七窍之中，渐渐渗出乌黑的血液，让他看起来如同地狱爬出的恶鬼。
他的身体剧烈抽搐着，身躯又快速消瘦下去。
楚枫站在原地，仿佛早已预料到这一切。
他抬手便是一巴掌，狠狠抽在了王澶的脸上。
王澶被这一巴掌抽得原地旋转了三圈，重重地摔在地上。
楚枫上前一步，抬脚狠狠踩在了王澶的脸上，鞋底碾压着他的脸颊，将他的脸深深踩进泥土之中。
“傻逼。”
这突如其来的变故，让在场的所有人都惊呆了。
子书禾身旁的几位长老，一个个瞠目结舌，嘴巴张得能塞进一个鸡蛋。
众人你看看我，我看看你，不由得窃窃私语。
“这、这是怎么回事，王澶这好像是中毒了？”
“他的修为怎么掉得这么快，元婴三重瞬间跌到金丹境了！”
“难道是楚枫搞的鬼，可我们根本没看到他动手啊！”

子书禾站在一旁，也是满脸震惊。
她刚才也以为楚枫必死无疑，可没想到，局势竟然会发生如此大的反转。
当看到墙角处王莹的尸体时，她瞳孔顿时一震。
王莹的尸体脸色乌黑发紫，七窍中也残留着淡淡的黑血痕迹，显然也是中毒而死。
一个念头如同闪电般划过子书禾的脑海，她瞬间想明白了事情的缘由。
刚才楚枫走到王莹身边，喂她吃了毒药，而王澶施展血脉献祭，吞噬了王莹的精血，自然也将那致命的毒素一同吞噬了下去。
“好狠的手段，好深的心机！”
地上的王澶剧烈地挣扎着，他的修为还在不断跌落，从金丹境一路下滑，很快就跌到了筑基九重。
“你对我做了什么？”
就在这时，他的目光不经意间扫过墙角处王莹的尸体，瞬间明白了过来。
“你、你给我孙女喂了毒药！”
楚枫脚下的力道又加重了几分。
“天咒腐血丹，顷刻之间便能让人体内的精血化为世间最毒的毒药。
你为了提升实力，不惜炼化自己一脉的所有子孙精血，却没想到连毒药也炼化了。”
楚枫在来之前便做了两手准备，若是正面交手不敌，便只能依靠一身炼丹的本领了。
他前世可是赤阳丹帝，除了炼丹救人，更擅长用毒。
王澶怎么也没想到，自己竟然栽在了一颗毒丹上。
“你……你到底想怎么样？”
他体内的毒素越来越猛烈，五脏六腑都像是被烈火焚烧一般，修为已经跌到了筑基三重，而且还在不断下降。
照这样下去，用不了多久，他就会彻底沦为一个没有修为的凡人。

一旦没有了修为，他这具身体撑不住十息。
楚枫低头看着他，眼神冰冷地问道。
“当年，你从我父亲手中得到的那枚令牌，在哪？”
“我说！我全都说！”
王澶感受到体内毒素的恐怖，彻底慌了。
“那枚令牌我已经献给三皇子了，根本没在我这！”
“胡说！”楚枫脚尖猛地碾动，直接踩碎了王澶的颧骨，“三皇子远在京师，他怎么可能知道我父亲从荒古禁地带出了一枚令牌？”
“啊——”
王澶发出一声凄厉的惨叫，连忙断断续续地解释道。
“我没有骗你，那枚令牌和天府秘境有关。
我也是偶然间才得知这个秘密，三皇子一直想要进入天府秘境，所以我才将令牌献给了他。”
“天府秘境？”
楚枫眉头微微一皱，天府秘境地处四国交界之地。
四国每年都会派遣年轻一代的天骄进入秘境历练，争夺里面的宝物。
没想到，父亲从荒古禁地带出来的那枚令牌，竟然与天府秘境有关。
王澶疼得浑身抽搐，他看着楚枫，苦苦哀求道。
“我知道的都已经告诉你了，快点救我，快给我解药，我不想死。”
“天咒腐血丹，根本就没有解药。”
话音刚落，楚枫一脚踩爆了他的脑袋。
所有人都静静地看着地上王澶的尸体，一个金丹境竟然毒杀了一个元婴强者。

这等手段，简直是闻所未闻！
楚枫踏着王澶的尸体，俯身拾起掉落在地的纳戒。
这枚纳戒品级不低，至少是中品储物戒。
他指尖凝聚一丝灵力，探入纳戒之中，神识如同潮水般席卷而过。
纳戒内部空间广阔，堆放着不少丹药，还有许多女子的贴身衣物。
楚枫对俗物兴趣不大，神识继续探查，很快便在纳戒深处，发现了一个玉简。
“天地阴阳秘典？”
楚枫心中一动，将玉简从纳戒中取出。
他翻开玉简，神识快速扫过其中的内容，越看越是心惊。
这竟是一部罕见的男女同修功法，可引动天地间的阴阳二气，将其炼化融合为己用，不仅能提升修炼速度，还能滋养肉身。
“难怪这老王八纳了三十八房小妾，原来这一身修为都是这么来的。”
楚枫心中暗自啧舌，王澶为了修炼这部功法，简直是无所不用其极，搜罗了这么多女子作为炉鼎。
不过，他很快便发现了不对劲。
这部《天地阴阳秘典》分为阳典和阴典，而王澶手中只有阳典。
即便如此，这部功法也算得上是顶级的同修功法，配合子书禾的极阴灵体，修炼速度也会快上数倍。
他下意识地转头，目光落在了不远处的子书禾身上。
阳光下，子书禾裙摆曳地，挺翘的臀线勾勒出优美的弧线。
想到她那极阴灵体的特性，再联想到《天地阴阳秘典》的玄妙，楚枫心中不由得泛起一丝燥热，有些迫不及待地想要和这个大漏斗试一试了。
“带我去宝库吧。”
城主府的宝库中定然藏着不少珍稀资源，若是能将其炼化，再配合功法与子书禾的极阴灵体，他的修为定然能再次突破。

“不行！”
楚枫的话音刚落，一道女声便骤然响起。
只见一位身着紫色长老袍的中年女子快步走出人群，她双手叉腰冷声道。
“楚枫，虽然你帮我们杀了王澶，但你只不过是个外人。
王家的宝库，凭什么让你进去？”
这女子名叫王丹，乃是王家的长老，同时也是前任城主王云山的堂妹。
在她看来楚枫终究是外人，无权染指王家的根基。
楚枫的脸色瞬间冷了下来，眼神如同寒冰般扫过王丹。
四长老见状，心中咯噔一下，连忙站出来打圆场。
他脸上堆着笑容，语气委婉地说道。
“王丹长老，话不能这么说。
楚枫帮我们除掉了王澶这个大患，还驯服了天煞鬼虎，保住了城主府，进入宝库挑选些宝物作为回报也是应该的。”
他这话看似在为楚枫说话，实则依旧将楚枫当成了外人，暗示宝库的所有权依旧属于王家。
岂料，不等楚枫开口，王丹便转头瞪向四长老。
“四长老，你这话就不对了，又不是我们求他来帮忙的。
他驯服天煞鬼虎，难道就没有私心吗？
我看他分明是想趁机霸占城主府的宝库，觊觎我们王家的底蕴！”
她再次将目光投向楚枫，下巴微扬，语气决绝道。
“我告诉你楚枫，宝库是王家的根基，是历代先祖积攒下来的心血。
只要我王丹活着，你就休想踏进一步。”

“很好。”
楚枫缓缓点头，脸上没有丝毫怒意，反而带着一丝冰冷的平静。
他最讨厌的，就是这种不知死活的蠢货。
话音落下的瞬间，楚枫抬手便是一剑斩出。
嗤啦——
剑光快得极致，如同一道赤色闪电，在场的所有人都没有反应过来，甚至没能看清楚枫的动作。
王丹脸上的傲然还未消散，眼中甚至还带着一丝讥讽，突然就感觉到一股刺骨的寒意从头顶蔓延至脚底。
她下意识地想要运转灵力抵挡，可已经来不及了。
下一秒，她的身体便从头顶到胯部，被一剑劈成了两瓣。
鲜血喷涌而出！
王丹眼中满是难以置信的惊恐之色，她到死都没有想到，楚枫竟然敢在众目睽睽之下，如此果断地杀她。
她瞪大了眼睛，然后身体裂开了。
楚枫收剑而立，星辞剑上的血迹顺着剑身滑落。
他淡然地看着王丹的尸体，语气平静无波，却带着一股令人心悸的寒意。
“杀了你，我就能进宝库了。”
说罢，楚枫的目光缓缓扫过在场的所有长老。
“从今往后，没有什么王家，城主府姓楚。”
他顿了顿，继续说道。
“若是想要留下来，效忠于我，便可以继续担任长老，享受应有的待遇。
谁若是想走，我也不拦着，给你们自由。

但有一点，阻我者，死！”
最后一个字，如同惊雷般炸响在每个人的耳边，让众人浑身一颤。
众人毫不怀疑，楚枫是真的敢杀了他们，毕竟他杀的人已经够多的了。
他们面面相觑，谁也不敢再说半个不字。
王丹便是前车之鉴，楚枫绝非易于之辈，违抗他的下场，只有死路一条。
众人纷纷将目光投向了子书禾，想要看看这位城主夫人的态度。
毕竟，子书禾手中还握着城主令，是名义上的城主府掌控者。
子书禾站在原地，看着楚枫那霸气侧漏的模样，心中不由得一荡，脸上泛起一丝红晕。
她喜欢这样杀伐果断的男人，最重要是又强又硬！
反观王云山太过优柔寡断，性格窝囊，才会被王澶一步步架空，最终落得个惨死的下场。
若是王云山有楚枫一半的霸气，王澶也绝不可能掌控城主府大半的权力。
在众人的注视下，子书禾深吸一口气，莲步轻移，缓缓走到了楚枫的面前。
她主动伸出白皙的玉手，挽住了楚枫的手臂。
胸前那团高耸绵软的丰盈紧紧挤压在楚枫的胳膊上，将衣料撑出柔和的弧度。
紧接着，子书禾将手中的城主令递到了楚枫的面前。
“从今以后，楚枫便是青山城的城主，执掌城主府，掌控青山城的一切。”
content_en:
At this critical moment, a sudden change occurred!
"Uh-huh——"
Wang Chan suddenly let out a shrill scream, and the spiritual power in his body collapsed instantly.
He clutched his chest and spat out a large mouthful of black blood.
"What's going on?"
Wang Chan's eyes widened, but he didn't know why.
The spiritual power in his body was escaping crazily like a flood that broke a dam, and his cultivation level at the third level of Nascent Soul was actually falling at a speed visible to the naked eye!
What's even more terrifying is that black blood gradually seeped out of his seven orifices, making him look like an evil ghost crawling out of hell.
His body twitched violently, and his body quickly lost weight.
Chu Feng stood there, as if he had anticipated all this.
He raised his hand and slapped Wang Chan hard on the face.
Wang Chan was struck by the slap and spun around three times before falling heavily to the ground.
Chu Feng took a step forward, raised his foot and stepped hard on Wang Chan's face. The sole of his shoe crushed his cheek, and forced his face deeply into the soil.
"Idiot."
This sudden change shocked everyone present.
The elders beside Zi Shuhe were all dumbfounded, their mouths wide enough to fit an egg in.
Everyone looked at me and I looked at you, and couldn't help but whisper.
"W-what's going on? Wang Chan seems to be poisoned?"
"Why did his cultivation level drop so fast? The third level of Nascent Soul fell to the Golden Core realm in an instant!"
"Could it be Chu Feng's fault, but we didn't see him take action at all!"
Zi Shuhe stood aside with shock on his face.
She had thought that Chu Feng would definitely die just now, but she didn't expect that the situation would take such a big turn.
When she saw Wang Ying's body in the corner, her pupils suddenly trembled.
Wang Ying's body was black and purple, and there were faint traces of black blood remaining in her seven orifices. She had obviously died of poisoning.
A thought flashed through Zi Shuhe's mind like lightning, and she instantly understood the cause of the matter.
Just now, Chu Feng walked up to Wang Ying and fed her poison. Wang Chan used blood sacrifice to swallow Wang Ying's essence and blood, and naturally swallowed the deadly poison together.
"What a ruthless method, what a deep conspiracy!"
Wang Chan struggled violently on the ground, and his cultivation level continued to decline. He fell all the way from the Golden Core Realm, and soon fell to the ninth level of Foundation Establishment.
"What did you do to me?"
At this moment, his eyes inadvertently glanced at Wang Ying's body in the corner, and he understood instantly.
"You, you gave my granddaughter poison!"
The strength under Chu Feng's feet became a little stronger.
"The Heavenly Curse Rotten Blood Pill can turn the blood essence in a person's body into the most poisonous poison in the world in an instant.
In order to improve your strength, you did not hesitate to refine the essence and blood of all your descendants, but you did not expect that you would also refine poison. "
Chu Feng had made two preparations before coming. If he was defeated in a head-on confrontation, he would have to rely on his alchemy skills.
In his previous life, he was the Chiyang Pill Emperor. In addition to refining pills to save people, he was also good at using poison.
Wang Chan never expected that he would fall on a poisonous pill.
"You...what do you want?"
The toxins in his body became more and more intense, and his internal organs seemed to be burned by fire. His cultivation level had dropped to the third level of Foundation Establishment, and was still declining.
If this continues, it won't be long before he is completely reduced to a mortal without cultivation.
Once he loses his cultivation, his body cannot last ten breaths.
Chu Feng looked down at him and asked with cold eyes.
"Where is the token you got from my father back then?"
"I said! I said everything!"
Wang Chan felt the terror of the toxins in his body and was completely panicked.
"I have already dedicated that token to the third prince, and it is not with me at all!"
"Nonsense!" Chu Feng stepped hard with his toes, directly crushing Wang Chan's cheekbones. "The third prince is far away in the capital. How could he know that my father came from the wilderness?"A token was brought out from the ancient forbidden area? "
"Ah——"
Wang Chan let out a shrill scream and quickly explained intermittently.
"I didn't lie to you, that token is related to the Tianfu Secret Realm.
I only learned this secret accidentally. The third prince has always wanted to enter the secret realm of Tianfu, so I dedicated the token to him. "
"The secret realm of Tianfu? "
Chu Feng frowned slightly. The secret realm of Tianfu is located at the junction of the four countries.
Every year, the four countries send their young talents into the secret realm to experience and compete for the treasures inside.
Unexpectedly, the token that my father took out from the ancient forbidden area was actually related to the secret realm of Tianfu.
Wang Chan twitched all over in pain. He looked at Chu Feng and begged.
"I've told you everything I know. Please save me quickly and give me the antidote. I don't want to die. "
“There is no antidote for the Heavenly Curse Rotten Blood Pill. "
As soon as he finished speaking, Chu Feng stepped on his head and exploded it.
Everyone silently looked at Wang Chan's body on the ground. A Jindan realm poisoned a Nascent Soul expert.
Such methods are simply unheard of!
Chu Feng stepped on Wang Chan's body and leaned over to pick up the Najie that fell to the ground.
The grade of this storage ring is not low, at least it is a medium-grade storage ring.
He condensed a trace of spiritual power on his fingertips, probed into the Najie, and his spiritual consciousness swept through it like a tide.
The inner space of Najie is vast, with many elixirs piled up, as well as many women's intimate clothes.
Chu Feng had little interest in common things, so he continued to explore with his spiritual sense, and soon found a jade slip deep in the Najie.
“The Secret Code of Yin and Yang of Heaven and Earth? "
Chu Feng's heart moved and he took out the jade slip from the ring.
He opened the jade slip, and his consciousness quickly scanned the contents. The more he read, the more frightened he became.
This is actually a rare technique for both men and women to practice. It can activate the yin and yang qi between heaven and earth, refine and fuse them for one's own use. It can not only increase the speed of cultivation, but also nourish the physical body.
"No wonder this old bastard took in thirty-eight concubines. It turns out that this is how he got his cultivation. "
Chu Feng secretly clicked his tongue in his heart. In order to practice this technique, Wang Chan went to great lengths to collect so many women as cauldrons.
However, he soon discovered something was wrong.
This "Secret Code of Yin and Yang of Heaven and Earth" is divided into Yang Code and Yin Code, and Wang Chan only has the Yang Code in his hands.
Even so, this technique can be regarded as a top-notch technique for fellow practitioners. When combined with Zi Shuhe's extremely yin spirit body, the training speed will be several times faster.
He turned his head subconsciously and his eyes fell on Zi Shuhe not far away.
Under the sun, Zi Shuhe's skirt fluttered on the floor, and her straight hips outlined a graceful arc.
Thinking of the characteristics of her extremely yin spirit body, and then thinking of the mystery of the "Secret Book of Yin and Yang of Heaven and Earth", Chu Feng couldn't help but feel a little hot in his heart, and he couldn't wait to have a try with this big funnel.
“Take me to the treasure house. "
There must be many rare resources hidden in the treasure house of the City Lord's Mansion. If he can refine them and combine them with the exercises and Zi Shuhe's extremely yin spirit body, his cultivation level will definitely be able to break through again.
"No! "
As soon as Chu Feng finished speaking, a female voice suddenly sounded.
I saw a middle-aged woman wearing a purple elder's robe quickly walking out of the crowd. She put her hands on her hips and said coldly.
"Chu Feng, although you helped us kill Wang Chan, you are just an outsider.
Why should you be allowed in the Wang family's treasure house? "
This woman's name is Wang Dan, she is an elder of the Wang family and the cousin of the former city lord Wang Yunshan.
In her opinion, Chu Feng was an outsider after all and had no right to touch the foundation of the Wang family.
Chu Feng's face instantly turned cold, and his eyes swept over Wang Dan like ice.
When the fourth elder saw this, his heart skipped a beat, and he quickly stepped forward to smooth things over.
He said with a smile on his face and his tone was tactful.
"Elder Wang Dan, you can't say that.
Chu Feng helped us get rid of the serious problem of Wang Chan, tamed the evil ghost tiger, saved the city lord's palace, and entered the treasure house to select some treasures asReturns are also due. "
His words seemed to be speaking for Chu Feng, but in fact he still regarded Chu Feng as an outsider, implying that the ownership of the treasure house still belonged to the Wang family.
Unexpectedly, before Chu Feng could speak, Wang Dan turned his head and glared at the fourth elder.
"Fourth Elder, what you said is wrong. We didn't ask him for help.
Doesn't he have selfish motives for taming the evil spirits and ghost tigers?
I think he clearly wants to take advantage of the opportunity to occupy the treasure house of the City Lord's Mansion and covet the heritage of our Wang family! "
She turned her gaze to Chu Feng again, raised her chin slightly, and spoke decisively.
"I tell you Chu Feng, the treasure house is the foundation of the Wang family and the hard work accumulated by the ancestors of all generations.
As long as I, Wang Dan, am alive, you will never take a step forward. "
"very good. "
Chu Feng nodded slowly, without any anger on his face, but with a trace of cold calm.
What he hates most is this kind of idiot who doesn't know how to live or die.
The moment he finished speaking, Chu Feng raised his hand and slashed out with his sword.
Tsk-
The sword light was extremely fast, like a red lightning bolt. No one present could react or even see Feng's movements clearly.
The pride on Wang Dan's face had not dissipated, and there was even a hint of sarcasm in his eyes. Suddenly, he felt a biting chill spreading from the top of his head to the soles of his feet.
She subconsciously wanted to use her spiritual power to resist, but it was too late.
The next second, her body was split into two pieces by a sword from the top of her head to her crotch.
Blood spurts out!
Wang Dan's eyes were filled with unbelievable horror. She never imagined until her death that Chu Feng would dare to kill her so decisively in front of everyone.
Her eyes widened, then her body split.
Chu Feng put away his sword and stood up. The blood on Xingci's sword slid down the sword's body.
He looked at Wang Dan's body indifferently, his tone calm, but with a chill that made people's hearts palpitate.
“If I kill you, I can enter the treasure house. "
After saying that, Chu Feng's eyes slowly swept across all the elders present.
"From now on, there will be no Wang family, and the city lord's surname is Chu. "
He paused and continued.
“If you want to stay and be loyal to me, you can continue to serve as an elder and enjoy the treatment you deserve.
If anyone wants to leave, I won't stop you and will give you freedom.
